metric: Hoop G: hardest 0.5 s of sideways acceleration on Run-the-Hoop, z within Combine year
use: film flag for day-3/undrafted (pick>=103) rushers in the class top third of Hoop G; never moves the board order on its own
test: 2026 Combine class after its first NFL season: slope of Hoop G (mean of graded laps) on (pressure rate - pick + role forecast frozen on the 2023-25 classes), within-class permutation, one-sided p<0.10; slope <= 0 retires the flag
baseline: pick + role (log draft pick, NFL EDGE share): the strongest no-tracking forecast held out on 2023-25
decision_date: after Week 18 of the 2026 regular season
